nodes.norm_label: interaction / accuracy radius rings (purple circle, dashed cyan)

nodes.label: New Spot Reroll Button (3 left)

nodes.label: Beacon Screen (StreetQuest UI Screenshot)

nodes.norm_label: bottom navigation bar (nearby, base, play, jobs, crew, hero)

nodes.label: Dark Leaflet/OpenStreetMap Basemap (London Bridge)
nodes.rationale: Dark-themed tiles make colorful game markers and rings stand out; OSM attribution shown bottom-right.

nodes.label: Floating Glassy HUD Overlay Layout
nodes.rationale: Rounded dark translucent cards float over the map in top and bottom bands, leaving the center clear for the player and nearby targets.

nodes.label: Interaction / Reach Radius Rings (purple solid + cyan dashed)
nodes.norm_label: interaction / reach radius rings (purple solid + cyan dashed)
nodes.rationale: Visualizes GPS-based pickup/interaction range so players know what they can reach without walking.

nodes.label: Collectible Item Markers (gem, toolbox, donut, star, flag)
nodes.norm_label: collectible item markers (gem, toolbox, donut, star, flag)

nodes.norm_label: active quest card (boots on the ground 0/3)

nodes.label: Raid Alert Banner (Raiders -> Crew Base, 8 incoming, GO)
nodes.norm_label: raid alert banner (raiders -> crew base, 8 incoming, go)
nodes.rationale: Urgent red banner with countdown and a single prominent GO CTA creates time pressure and a one-tap response to base defense.

nodes.label: StreetQuest Map Screen Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Primary gameplay screen: full-bleed dark map with floating HUD overlays so the real-world location stays the focus.

nodes.label: Goal Countdown (ends in 4d 10h)
nodes.rationale: Time-limited events create urgency

nodes.label: Faction Goal Card (Total War)
nodes.rationale: Faction-level count goal (3 / 150) driving team competition

nodes.label: Play Bottom Sheet
nodes.rationale: Draggable sheet with grab handle, help (?) and close (X) buttons; overlays the map instead of navigating away

nodes.label: Play Tabs (Story / GPS games / Goals)
nodes.rationale: Pill-style segmented tabs; active Goals tab highlighted in yellow

nodes.label: Player HUD (Avatar, Name, Rank, Level, XP Bar)
nodes.norm_label: player hud (avatar, name, rank, level, xp bar)

nodes.label: Shared Reward (XP / Coins / Gems for everyone who helps)
nodes.norm_label: shared reward (xp / coins / gems for everyone who helps)

nodes.label: World Operation Card (Operation Long March)
nodes.rationale: Global cooperative distance goal (0.0 km / 2000 km) where every player's walking contributes; shows personal contribution to motivate participation

nodes.label: Goals Screen (Play Sheet)
nodes.rationale: Shows community/cooperative time-limited goals in a bottom sheet over the live map so players keep map context while checking progress

nodes.label: Browser-Based, No Download
nodes.rationale: 'Open in your phone's browser - no download' highlights web app delivery, removing app-store install friction

nodes.label: From Home Mode (No Walking Needed)
nodes.rationale: Accessibility option letting users play without moving, implicitly with reduced rewards versus walk mode

nodes.label: Neon Dark Visual Style
nodes.rationale: Dark blurred bokeh background with neon pink/cyan/green accents and glassmorphism cards

nodes.label: Play Free CTA
nodes.rationale: Prominent green glowing button; free-to-play positioning reduces signup friction

nodes.label: StreetQuest Brand
nodes.rationale: Logo rendered as white 'STREET' + neon pink 'QUEST' with glow, establishing an arcade/neon visual identity

nodes.label: Tagline: Your City Is The Game
nodes.norm_label: tagline: your city is the game
nodes.rationale: Cyan glowing tagline communicating the real-world location-based gameplay premise

nodes.label: Walk Mode (Full Rewards)
nodes.rationale: Real-location play mode; incentivized with full rewards to encourage physical movement

nodes.label: StreetQuest Ad Image
nodes.rationale: Vertical (9:16) mobile promotional poster for StreetQuest on a blurred dark neon city-map background, designed for social/story ad placements

nodes.label: StreetQuest Brand Mark (Yellow Map Pin with Pink Star)
nodes.norm_label: streetquest brand mark (yellow map pin with pink star)
nodes.rationale: A yellow/amber gradient location pin with a thick dark-brown outline and a hot-pink star in its head, floating above a soft drop shadow on a pink-to-violet diagonal gradient background. The pin communicates GPS/real-world location; the star signals quests, rewards and collectibles; the saturated cartoon style signals a playful game.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (180px)
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed square with the pink-violet gradient background and centered pin-star mark, no rounded corners baked in, because iOS applies its own corner mask when the app is added to the home screen.

nodes.label: Notification Badge Icon (96px)
nodes.rationale: Renders as white on transparent (appears blank on a white background): a monochrome silhouette badge, as Android uses only the alpha channel for the small status-bar icon on push notifications.

nodes.label: Favicon (64px)
nodes.rationale: Small rounded-square version of the brand mark, with the pin enlarged relative to the frame so it stays legible in browser tabs and bookmarks.

nodes.label: PWA Icon (192px)
nodes.rationale: Standard 'any'-purpose web app manifest icon with transparent rounded corners, used for the Android home-screen launcher and install prompt.

nodes.label: PWA Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: High-resolution rounded-square manifest icon, required for PWA installability and used for the splash screen and app stores.

nodes.label: Maskable PWA Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed gradient with the pin mark shrunk into the central safe zone (about 80%), so Android adaptive-icon masks (circle, squircle, teardrop) never clip the logo.

nodes.label: Store and Sponsor Spots
nodes.rationale: Sponsor spots timed server-side with daily cap; purchases credited once per session by webhook or on return.

nodes.label: Service Worker Offline Cache and Update Prompt
nodes.norm_label: service worker offline cache and update prompt

nodes.label: Solar Time of Day and Daily Streaks
nodes.norm_label: solar time of day and daily streaks

nodes.label: Render Web Service (streetquest)
nodes.rationale: Node 22, free plan; build npm ci && npm run build, start npm start; health check on /robots.txt; AUTH_SECRET and ADMIN_KEY auto-generated.

nodes.label: Admin Panel
nodes.rationale: Admin granted by opening /admin?key=<ADMIN_KEY> once in a browser that has played.

nodes.label: GPS Anti-cheat (server trusted position, 250 km/h jump limit)
nodes.norm_label: gps anti-cheat (server trusted position, 250 km/h jump limit)

nodes.label: Clash of Clans Siege Rules (stars, trophies, leagues, shields)
nodes.norm_label: clash of clans siege rules (stars, trophies, leagues, shields)

nodes.label: Deeper RTS (counters, veterancy, research, General's Powers)
nodes.norm_label: deeper rts (counters, veterancy, research, general's powers)

nodes.label: Playwright End-to-End Tests (api + ui suites)
nodes.rationale: Run against a separate streetquest_e2e database; include double-tap race checks so identical concurrent requests never charge or pay twice.

nodes.label: Field Squads (real-time strategy on map)
nodes.rationale: Squad positions interpolated from march (from/to/depart/arrive); arrivals settled lazily by whoever looks at the map; battles reuse siege/outpost code.

nodes.label: FPS Base Breach Matches
nodes.rationale: Arena generated from match seed on every client; clients POST position + hits ~7x/s over HTTP polling; server owns HP/kills/result; first live human hosts bot/boss AI with failover. Casual-grade anti-cheat; move to WebSockets for scale.

nodes.label: Goals (world operation, faction goal, milestones)
nodes.rationale: Every questEvent feeds per-user, per-faction and world counters per week.

nodes.label: GPS Mini-games (Treasure Hunt, Street Sprint, Checkpoint Rally)
nodes.norm_label: gps mini-games (treasure hunt, street sprint, checkpoint rally)
nodes.rationale: Targets generated server-side around the trusted position; hidden spots never sent to the client.

nodes.label: Life Sim Layer (Sims-style needs)
nodes.rationale: Needs decay is computed from a stored snapshot + timestamp so no background jobs are required; mood multiplies XP in grant().

nodes.label: Live Game Settings (GameConfig overrides)
nodes.rationale: Every tunable has a default in lib/settings.ts; admin overrides stored in GameConfig, cached 15 s per instance, sent to clients via /api/me; applyConfig() updates constants in place on both sides so changes go live without redeploy.

nodes.label: Live Layer (polling /api/loc, /api/sync, chat)
nodes.rationale: Serverless-friendly polling (sync every 4 s, chat every 3 s, online = pinged in last 90 s); swap in a hosted realtime service behind notify() for scale.

nodes.label: Multiplayer Mini-game Lobbies (Shooting Range, Bomb Defuse)
nodes.norm_label: multiplayer mini-game lobbies (shooting range, bomb defuse)
nodes.rationale: One lobby per spawn, same seed for every player; state advances whenever a member polls; server caps scores with the same generator.

nodes.label: Territory Outposts
nodes.rationale: Deterministic outposts per ~900 m cell; only ownership + garrison are stored.

nodes.label: Raider Waves
nodes.rationale: Generated from a seed and fought by a deterministic simulation the server resolves once and clients animate.

nodes.label: SEO (SSR landing, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, PWA manifest)
nodes.norm_label: seo (ssr landing, json-ld, sitemap, robots, pwa manifest)

nodes.label: Deterministic Spawns (Pokemon-GO style)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic per ~450 m cell and 20-min window so everyone sees the same world with zero storage; server rebuilds a spawn from its id to verify claims.

nodes.label: Strategy Layer (Generals: Zero Hour style)
nodes.rationale: Rules are pure and shared between client and server (src/lib/rts.ts); battles are auto-resolved.

nodes.label: Test Mode (no GPS, teleport)
nodes.rationale: Lets players without walking test the game; TEST_MODE=off restricts it to admins in production.

nodes.label: Tower Defense on Real Map
nodes.rationale: Towers fire when a commander reports position via /api/loc -> takeFire; HP regenerates from a stored snapshot.

nodes.label: World Bosses
nodes.rationale: Deterministic per ~1.3 km region and 2 h window like spawns; only damage is stored; killing hit pays every contributor.

nodes.label: Render Deployment (Blueprint)
nodes.rationale: Free web services sleep after 15 min idle and free Postgres expires after 30 days.

nodes.label: StreetQuest (real-world GPS war game)
nodes.rationale: Several genres stacked on one real-world map; every layer feeds the others (hero bonuses change battle maths, mood scales XP, loot funds research, territory funds the army).

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.rationale: Every build runs scripts/db-sync.mjs to create/update tables; DB_CONNECTION_LIMIT caps each instance at 1 connection so direct URLs don't exhaust connections.

nodes.label: Deterministic Seeded World Generation
nodes.rationale: Content is derived from cell/time-window or match seeds so every client sees the same world with near-zero storage and the server can re-derive content to verify claims.

nodes.label: Lazy Snapshot + Timestamp Evaluation
nodes.rationale: State (needs, tower HP, squad arrivals) is computed on read from a stored snapshot and timestamp, avoiding background jobs in a serverless deployment.
